Maria (ml): bringing up hyperion14b q4f on the eval harness — seeing weird splits in chat templates where assistant markers get tokenized into two tokens and the runner's collate logic drops the first piece. reproduces locally with tokenizer.dump_tokens, but CI shows different behavior. anyone seen this?

Sam: can you paste a minimal example? also which tokenizer (sentencepiece / bpe)?

Maria (ml): it's our gptish-bpe v2. minimal: `User: Hi\nAssistant: Hello` -> tokens: ["User", ":", "ĠHi", "\nAs", "sistant", ":", "ĠHello"] — note `Assistant` split into `As` + `sistant`. collate then treats "\nAs" as prefix and sometimes drops `As` when merging kv caches.

Lee: ugh that split looks like a subword boundary we didn't normalize. quick fix might be to normalize chat separators to explicit sentinel `<|assistant|>` so tokenizer preserves it as one token. but that changes eval templates (affects metrics).

Anuj: CI runner failure stack (short):
```
EVAL_RUNNER: collate_batch failed for model=hyperion14b q4f
Trace: kv_cache_merge: expected prefix_len==len(prefix) but got shorter
Context: sample 42, tokens: [.. "\nAs", "sistant", ..]
```
This is causing flaky regression in summarization bench (metric diff ~0.6n in rouge).

DevEx: we should add a small harness-level normalization step that maps common chat separators to a canonical sentinel before tokenization and de-normalize for metric text. Add a unit test in eval-harness/tests/tokenization_test.py that asserts `dump_tokens(sep)` is atomic.

Sam: agree on normalization. also let's add a CI gate: if tokenizer.dump_tokens changes between runner and local (different versions), fail with a hint. right now CI just retries and masks the error.

Maria (ml): created a branch `ml/hyperion14b-token-normalize` with a prototype: replaces `\nAssistant:` -> `<|assistant|>` in the chat template pre-tokenize, and a postprocess to revert before metric scoring. pushing patch in 2h.

CI Bot: Pipeline #4872 failed on `e2e-eval-harness` (flaky tokenization). See logs: https://ci.internal/reports/4872

Lee: when you push, add a short note in the PR description about potential metric drift and a link to the eval-case used (summarization/nyt). we'll need to run the full eval-job on dedicated infra to verify cost/latency impact.

Anuj: one more thing — quantify the effect of changing separators on model outputs (small prompt difference can shift outputs). recommend A/B run: current vs canonical sentinel on 5k samples, compare top-1 metrics and token length distribution. I can wire the pipeline if you want.

Maria (ml): thanks — will do A/B run once branch lands. tagging @DevEx for test helpers and @Anuj for eval job. :thumbsup:

DevEx: noted — will add the test and a CI check to `eval-harness` job. keep the PR small and reversible.

Sam: thanks team. if anyone hits other hyperion token quirks ping here.
